scenarios.title: A｜普通回复
scenarios.setting: 几个月没有联系的前任突然发来消息。

turns.text: Hey. It’s been a while. How have you been?

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Hey. Yeah, it has. I’ve been doing pretty well. How about you?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey. Yeah, it has. I’ve been doing pretty well. How about you?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Hi. I’m good, thanks. Hope you’re doing well too.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi. I’m good, thanks. Hope you’re doing well too.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Hey! I’m doing okay. What have you been up to?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey! I’m doing okay. What have you been up to?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’m good. I wasn’t expecting to hear from you.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m good. I wasn’t expecting to hear from you.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: I’ve been good. I saw something today that reminded me of you.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Oh really? What was it?

feedback.naturalExpression: Oh really? What was it?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Haha, should I be worried?

feedback.naturalExpression: Haha, should I be worried?
feedback.explanation: 关系尚可时可调侃

choices.text: That’s funny. What made you think of me?

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s funny. What made you think of me?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Ah, I see. That’s probably why you messaged me then.

feedback.naturalExpression: Ah, I see. That’s probably why you messaged me then.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: Yeah. I wasn’t sure if I should text you.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: It’s okay. I don’t mind hearing from you.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s okay. I don’t mind hearing from you.

feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

feedback.naturalExpression: I was surprised, but it’s fine.

scenarios.title: B｜拒绝继续联系
scenarios.setting: 在“前任突然联系”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“拒绝继续联系”。

turns.text: I’ve been thinking about you lately. Maybe we could talk more again?

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: I appreciate you reaching out, but I don’t think staying in contact is a good idea for me.

feedback.naturalExpression: I appreciate you reaching out, but I don’t think staying in contact is a good idea for me.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I think it’s better if we keep our distance.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think it’s better if we keep our distance.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’ve moved on, and I’d rather not start talking regularly again.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve moved on, and I’d rather not start talking regularly again.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I don’t have any hard feelings, but I don’t want to reopen that part of my life.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t have any hard feelings, but I don’t want to reopen that part of my life.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: We don’t have to get back together. Can’t we just be friends?

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: I understand, but I still don’t think that’s something I want.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand, but I still don’t think that’s something I want.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I don’t think being friends would be healthy for me right now.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t think being friends would be healthy for me right now.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Maybe that works for some people, but it doesn’t feel right for me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Maybe that works for some people, but it doesn’t feel right for me.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’m not angry with you. I just need this boundary.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not angry with you. I just need this boundary.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: So you don’t want me to contact you anymore?

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Yeah. I’d prefer if we didn’t stay in contact.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah. I’d prefer if we didn’t stay in contact.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I think that’s best for me. I hope you can respect that.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think that’s best for me. I hope you can respect that.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Yes. I wish you well, but I’d like us to go our separate ways.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. I wish you well, but I’d like us to go our separate ways.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Thank you. Take care.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. Take care.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I appreciate that. I wish you the best.

feedback.naturalExpression: I appreciate that. I wish you the best.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

scenarios.title: C｜对方提出复合
scenarios.setting: 在“前任突然联系”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“对方提出复合”。

turns.text: Can I be honest? Part of the reason I messaged you is that I still think about us.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: What do you mean?

feedback.naturalExpression: What do you mean?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Are you saying you want to get back together?

feedback.naturalExpression: Are you saying you want to get back together?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I had a feeling this might be about us. What are you asking?

feedback.naturalExpression: I had a feeling this might be about us. What are you asking?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: Yeah. I miss you. I’ve been wondering if we made a mistake breaking up.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: What makes you think things would be different this time?

feedback.naturalExpression: What makes you think things would be different this time?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I miss parts of our relationship too, but we broke up for a reason.

feedback.naturalExpression: I miss parts of our relationship too, but we broke up for a reason.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’ve thought about it too, but I’m not sure getting back together is a good idea.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve thought about it too, but I’m not sure getting back together is a good idea.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’m willing to talk about it, but I’m not promising anything.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m willing to talk about it, but I’m not promising anything.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I don’t want to return together.

feedback.naturalExpression: What makes you think things would be different this time?
feedback.explanation: “复合”常说 get back together

turns.text: I’ve changed a lot since we broke up. I think we could do things differently now.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: What do you think has actually changed?

feedback.naturalExpression: What do you think has actually changed?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’m glad you feel that way, but I’d need more than a promise.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m glad you feel that way, but I’d need more than a promise.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: If we even considered trying again, we’d have to talk honestly about what went wrong before.

feedback.naturalExpression: If we even considered trying again, we’d have to talk honestly about what went wrong before.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I hear you, but I don’t feel the same way anymore.

feedback.naturalExpression: I hear you, but I don’t feel the same way anymore.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: I’m not saying no, but I need time to think about it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not saying no, but I need time to think about it.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I think it is. I’ve moved on, and I don’t want to go back.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think it is. I’ve moved on, and I don’t want to go back.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’m open to talking, but I want to take things very slowly.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m open to talking, but I want to take things very slowly.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Yes. I’m sorry, but I don’t want to get back together.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. I’m sorry, but I don’t want to get back together.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。
